tasks.title: Result history docs explain idempotent submissions and complete timestamp groups
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api — Tasks and checks, documentation acceptance 1-8, documentation inventory, runtime acceptance, tests and performance, scope gates and completion evidence; Required behavior (documentation) items 1-2; Non-goals, Counterexamples and Security impact. Correct only the result-history paging paragraph and the Health and metrics README paragraph. Describe uniqueness on (check, location, timestamp), complete boundary timestamp groups across locations, five tied locations returning five rows for limit=1, and five identical submissions storing one sample. Keep the two required sentences/phrases, the exclusive last-timestamp cursor and existing claims. Add the README clarification and result-history link while preserving its idempotence and location-health text. No source, test, config, dependency, CI, bench or website changes; temporary verification scripts and fixtures stay outside the checkout.

acceptance.expected: Before any edit, record the full implementation-base SHA as BASE, retained for all later scope checks, and Bun 1.4.0. The inspected base is e084bde0a5bc199748ec5614ed604ae79b8454cf. If the actual base differs, refresh source citations and rerun each listed baseline control three times on that base, including runtime characterization, recording exact commands/results; focused runs must exit 0 with 27 pass and 0 fail and full checks with 904 pass and 0 fail and the existing coverage threshold. Diagnose discrepancies rather than claiming historical evidence for a different base.

acceptance.command: grep -cF 'A retried submission can store several rows' docs/rest-api.md; grep -cF '5 rows for `limit=1`' docs/rest-api.md
acceptance.expected: Documentation checks 1-2: each prints 0 and has grep no-match exit 1; recorded base prints 1 for each. Remove the stale retry-causes-duplicates sentence and its misleading example. No-match exit 1 here is expected, not a failed verification.

acceptance.command: grep -cF 'so it can exceed `limit` across locations' docs/rest-api.md && grep -cF 'Five identical submissions from one location store one sample' docs/rest-api.md
acceptance.expected: Documentation checks 3-4: each prints exactly 1, exit 0; recorded base prints 0 for each. The prose explains a complete boundary timestamp group, at most one result per location within that timestamp, five distinct locations at one timestamp returning all five for limit=1, and five identical submissions from one location returning one row. Include the required sentences from Required behavior item 1. Do not bound a whole page by its number of locations or promise location order or a snapshot.

acceptance.command: grep -cF 'Nothing is skipped or repeated.' docs/rest-api.md && grep -cF 'Epoch ms, exclusive cursor: only older results.' docs/rest-api.md && grep -cF 'Default 100, capped at 1000.' docs/rest-api.md && grep -cF 'The first post wins' docs/rest-api.md && grep -cx '## GET /checks/:id/results' docs/rest-api.md
acceptance.expected: Documentation check 5: each prints exactly 1 and exits 0, as on the recorded base. Retain newest-first results, last-item timestamp as exclusive before cursor, defaults, cap, errors, response shape and generated-heartbeat exception. Nothing is skipped or repeated describes traversal of an unchanged sample set.

acceptance.command: grep -cF '(docs/rest-api.md#get-checksidresults)' README.md && grep -cF '`POST /results` is idempotent on (check, location, timestamp)' README.md && grep -cF 'See [REST API](docs/rest-api.md#get-locations).' README.md && grep -cF 'There is no import.' README.md
acceptance.expected: Documentation checks 6-7: each prints exactly 1 and exits 0; the first is 0 on the base and the others are 1. The new link is [GET /checks/:id/results](docs/rest-api.md#get-checksidresults) and resolves to the existing heading. The short README clarification says a re-send stores no second row and a result page retains the whole timestamp group and can exceed limit across locations. Preserve the existing idempotence sentence, location-health statement and trailing REST API link.

Create this temporary assertion outside the checkout before editing; it independently asserts the literal counts in documentation checks 1-4 and 6, never derives expected phrases from the edited documents. Run it against an isolated copy of recorded BASE three times: nonzero each time specifically because the stale sentence/example remains or a required new phrase/link is absent. Run the identical assertion against the completed branch: exit 0. Save all three red results and the green result; add no checked-in test.

acceptance.command: rg -n 'retried|several rows|idempotent|re-send|same timestamp|unique on|repeat|whole group|exceed `limit`|no unique key|repeated post' README.md docs/*.md bench/README.md
acceptance.expected: Repeat this documentation inventory on recorded BASE and the branch, classifying every relevant claim with exact lines and proving text. Changed: docs/rest-api.md:167 and README.md:78 on the base. Unchanged and still true: docs/rest-api.md:84,88,90,160-165,169-172,636; docs/operation.md:23,31,332; docs/concepts.md:50; docs/configuration.md:98-99; bench/README.md:139 (historical side A before the unique key). Record unrelated broad matches as unrelated with their context. docs/index.md, docs/install.md, docs/development.md and docs/troubleshooting.md have no additional duplicate-sample or timestamp-group claim needing correction. Protect all unchanged documents in the scope gates.

Read the entire committed diff and every added line. Exactly the single paging paragraph under GET /checks/:id/results and the Health and metrics paragraph at base README.md:78 change, kept on one line like their neighbours. All other bytes in both files remain unchanged. No altered ingest, uniqueness, pagination, heartbeat rules, settings, endpoints or types. README and REST prose agree; a page can contain several timestamps, so do not imply a page has at most one row per location. List every added comment, including inline comments, in the PR body; write none only after this full read (expected none for Markdown prose).

Implement this temporary real-route harness outside the checkout and run on BASE and branch. Start bun start with fresh temporary PULSE_DB, PULSE_CHECKS_FILE and PULSE_TOKENS_FILE, five location-bound non-placeholder probe tokens at least 16 characters long, an available PORT and non-heartbeat checks; wait for /readyz 200. Capture one valid current timestamp and fixed payload once. Five identical posts from one token return 204 204 204 204 204; both default GET /checks/<id>/results and ?limit=1 return 200 and exactly 1 row at that timestamp and location. On a separate check, post one sample at T from each of five matching location tokens and one older at T-1000: ?limit=1 returns 200 and exactly 5 rows all at T; ?limit=1&before=T returns 200 and exactly 1 row at T-1000. Traverse with the last timestamp as before until an empty 200 page; exactly 6 distinct samples, no omissions or repeats. SIGTERM stops the service with exit 0. Save sanitized commands and outputs without tokens and leave no fixtures in the checkout. Do not reuse the changing-timestamp curl example or vary locations under one token.

acceptance.command: for round in 1 2 3; do bun test --config=/dev/null src/service.idempotent.test.ts src/server.reads.test.ts src/docs-claims.test.ts || exit $?; done
acceptance.expected: Each branch run exits 0 with 27 pass, 0 fail and no focused coverage table, using Bun 1.4.0. The empty config override is verified on the recorded base; without it focused tests pass but the coverage gate exits 1. Do not change bunfig.toml or any checked-in test. Save all three command/results.

acceptance.command: for round in 1 2 3; do (cd "$PULSE_861_BASE_CHECKOUT" && /usr/bin/time -f 'base user=%U sys=%S' bun run check) || exit $?; /usr/bin/time -f 'branch user=%U sys=%S' bun run check || exit $?; done
acceptance.expected: Prepare PULSE_861_BASE_CHECKOUT as an isolated disposable checkout outside the implementation repository at exactly recorded BASE with frozen-lockfile dependencies and verify its SHA first. Run base, branch, base, branch, base, branch on the same machine. Every bun run check exits 0 with lint and typecheck green, 904 pass, 0 fail and the unchanged repository 80% line-coverage threshold enforced; no exact coverage percentage is an expectation. These provide the required three full branch runs. Report revisions, commands, pass counts, raw user+sys CPU samples and the branch-minus-base delta as information on the shared noisy machine. No Docker bench (#834); Compose end-to-end testing belongs to pulse-deploy and is not required for this two-file API documentation correction.

After the last commit, committed scope gate 1 prints exactly these two sorted lines: README.md and docs/rest-api.md, nothing else. Assert equality to that literal two-file list rather than merely printing or filtering it. Use the recorded full implementation BASE, never HEAD~1 or a moving ref.

acceptance.command: git diff --name-only --cached && git diff --name-only && git status --porcelain
acceptance.expected: After the last commit, scope gates 2, 3 and 4 each separately produce empty output and exit 0: no staged changes, no unstaged changes and no untracked files. Assert emptiness for each gate independently; git diff's default success status alone does not prove empty output.

acceptance.command: git diff --exit-code "$BASE" HEAD -- docs/concepts.md docs/configuration.md docs/development.md docs/index.md docs/install.md docs/operation.md docs/troubleshooting.md bench AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md src test package.json bun.lock bunfig.toml biome.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js lefthook.yml .github Dockerfile scripts
acceptance.expected: After the last commit, protected-path scope gate 5 exits 0 with empty output. All unchanged inventoried documents (including bench/README.md via bench), source, tests, ingest, uniqueness, pagination, config, dependencies, tooling, CI, Dockerfile and scripts remain identical to recorded BASE. The exact allow-list gate rejects every other changed path even if not enumerated here.

Create this temporary harness and disposable clone outside the implementation checkout; implement the same five gates above with explicit exact-list/empty-output assertions and save expected and actual exit/status for each gate in each independent fixture state. Clean committed changes to exactly README.md and docs/rest-api.md pass all gates. A committed protected change fails gates 1 and 5; a staged protected change fails 2 and 4; an unstaged protected change fails 3 and 4; an untracked file fails 4. Include both restored-worktree cases: stage a protected change then restore only its working-tree bytes to BASE, which still fails gate 2; commit a protected change then restore only its working-tree bytes to BASE, which still fails gates 1 and 5. Do not reset the index or commit while restoring these worktree bytes. Report every gate result, including additional failures from the restored cases. The harness exits 0 only when all expected passes and failures are observed; no fixture mutates the implementation checkout.

The PR changes exactly README.md and docs/rest-api.md and names Closes lorenzh/pulse-meta#<child> with the actual child issue number. Its body includes recorded BASE and branch SHA, documentation checks 1-7 with literal counts, the baseline/branch inventory classifications and proving lines, full two-file diff review, three red temporary documentation assertions and the green branch assertion, three focused and three full branch results and any refreshed base controls, sanitized real-route transcript, interleaved CPU raw samples/delta, all five final scope gate outputs, fixture expected/actual results including both restored-worktree cases, checks run and known limits. List every added comment after reading all added lines (expected none). Verify Security impact: no from the two-file documentation-only scope: no route, auth, parser, client, write, log, dependency, Dockerfile or CI change. State behavior is unchanged and the website receives the prose at its next independent docs pin bump. No benchmark, source, test, fixture or note files are added to this API PR.
